Software Requirements Specification
Need an alert in the system to notify users that the PO has already been created based on the initial color and size dependency
Document # 349905
Version 1.0 ● 08/12/2025

# Section 1: Overview

# Purpose
The purpose of this document is to define the system enhancement required to introduce a permission to the internal configuration setting “RestrictChangeInCSDepIfPOCreated.” This enhancement ensures that once a PO (Purchase Order) is created, changes to CS Department (Cost Sheet Department) fields will be restricted unless the user holds a specific override permission.

# Business Requirement
Currently this setting is internal and there is no permission to a specific user to change in case of specific cases so permission required for the internal setting. If permission is given to the user then user must allow to change the dependency.

# Section 2. Solution
Currently this setting is internal and there is no permission to a specific user to change in case of specific cases so permission required for the internal setting. If permission is given to the user then user must allow to change the dependency.
